use anyhow::{ensure,Result};use erc20_balances_storage_tools::{data::*,rpc::*};use serde_json::{json,Value};use std::{fs,path::Path,time::Duration};
fn main()->Result<()>{let root=Path::new("erc20/balances-storage");let out=root.join("out/og450-model-source");fs::create_dir(&out)?;let rpc=HttpRpc::from_env();let header=rpc.header(122288107)?;let at=block_ref(text(&header["hash"])?);let agent=ureq::AgentBuilder::new().timeout(Duration::from_secs(30)).build();let mut report=vec![];for address in ["0xe18102869d32181aea317a40c5c4ce90ca591913","0x1430c0bd0d023690f7aee3666daf265c498cc6a5"] {let runtime=rpc.call("eth_getCode",json!([address,at]))?;let bytes=hex::decode(text(&runtime)?.trim_start_matches("0x"))?;fs::write(out.join(format!("{address}.hex")),text(&runtime)?)?;let url=format!("https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/56/{address}?fields=all");let response=agent.get(&url).call();match response{Ok(response)=>{let s:Value=response.into_json()?;let p=out.join(format!("{address}-source.json"));fs::write(&p,serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&s)?)?;let bound=s["runtimeBytecode"]["onchainBytecode"]==runtime && (s["runtimeMatch"]=="match"||s["runtimeMatch"]=="exact_match");if bound {for(name,source)in s["sources"].as_object().into_iter().flatten(){if let Some(content)=source["content"].as_str(){let name=name.replace('/',"_");fs::write(out.join(format!("{address}-{name}")),content)?;}}}report.push(json!({"address":address,"source_status":"available","runtime_bytes":bytes.len(),"runtime_hash":format!("0x{}",hex::encode(erc20_balances_storage::hash(&bytes))),"bound":bound,"source_sha256":sha256(&p)?,"url":url,"compilation":s["compilation"],"storage_layout":s["storageLayout"]}));},Err(ureq::Error::Status(status,response))=>{fs::write(out.join(format!("{address}-source-error.txt")),response.into_string()?)?;report.push(json!({"address":address,"source_status":status,"runtime_bytes":bytes.len(),"runtime_hash":format!("0x{}",hex::encode(erc20_balances_storage::hash(&bytes))),"bound":false,"url":url}));},Err(_)=>anyhow::bail!("public source transport failed")};}ensure!(rpc.header(122288107)?["hash"]==header["hash"],"fork");fs::write(out.join("report.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"status":"inspected","block":122288107,"hash":header["hash"],"contracts":report}))?)?;Ok(())}
